turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail: m Flo 🩸: Yes—we ship internationally. - Canada orders: No tariffs or duties. - US orders: Prices include applicable tariffs or import fees, so you won’t be charged extra at checkout or on delivery. - Exception: Orders over $750 USD may be subject to U.S. CBP Import Duties, Taxes and Fees, payable by the customer to the delivery courier. - International orders (outside of North America): Import duties, taxes, and associated administrative fees are the customer’s responsibility (as the importer).
